name: Cellular Provider Credential Mediator
description: The one node in the cellular-network-aggregate flow that holds a credential capability (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no base64 between modules; every hostcall an SDS $PIV invocation through sdm_piv). It opens a browser-sealed provider credential with the host's keyslot oracle (keyslot.unwrap, gated by wallet_sign — the host has no separate keyslot capability name) and writes it to the node's machine-bound credential store (secrets.put, the secret on the raw "secret" frame), per lane, under a write grant that is SEPARATE from the read grant by Seal Council condition. It also finishes the provider catalog the router builds (a $QRP projection page): it fills the node's X25519 wrapping key slot (node.publicKey, the raw key bytes in a Bytes cell, rendered base64 only by http-respond's Json representation) and flips the per-lane credentialConfigured/defaultSelected cells it reads back with secrets.status. It exists as its own plugin so that cell-tower-source — which parses provider payloads and is instantiated by the SDK browser harness in its own tests — can stay capabilities:[] and browser-targeted: wallet_sign is browser-incompatible by SDK compliance and secrets.* has no browser host implementation. The blast radius of every credential grant an operator makes for this flow is therefore this one artifact. It carries NO plaintext branch, echoes NO value in any output frame, CONTEXT or log, invents NO key slot, and refuses any lane not prefixed cell_.

sequentialJustification.detail: One method over one task: read the task, make at most a handful of synchronous typed hostcalls in a fixed order, emit one decision and one page (or the completed requests). No shared mutable state, no worker pool, no fan-out inside the guest. This guest can never spawn a thread, so it compiles wasi-sequential rather than claiming a wasi-threads contract it does not honour.

methods.description: Exactly one task kind per invocation, by port. "catalog": the router's $QRP provider projection page -> finished page (key slot cells from node.publicKey; credentialConfigured/defaultSelected true for each cell_ lane secrets.status reports configured) + a $QRP Request decision carrying the page's REPRESENTATION. "credential": the router's $APR task. ROUTE credential-put: the sealed keyslot envelope is the APR BODY verbatim (the browser's JSON {slotId, ephemeralPublicKey, nonce, ciphertext}, base64 fields decoded at this edge) -> keyslot.unwrap (KeyslotParams SLOT_ID provider-wrapping, ALGORITHM X25519; raw ephemeral_public_key, nonce, ciphertext) -> the plaintext {username, secret} -> secrets.put (SecretParams ID lane, USERNAME; raw secret); the plaintext is never pushed, logged or returned and is wiped after use. ROUTE credential-clear: secrets.clear, answered identically whether or not a credential was there so a write grant does not become a presence oracle. Success is a one-row $QRP projection (providerId, credentialLane, credentialConfigured, stored|cleared); a refusal is a $QRP KIND Error decision with HTTP_STATUS, ERROR_CODE and MESSAGE (bad-lane 400, unsealed-credential 400, unknown-key-slot 400, unwrap-failed 400, empty-secret 400, username-too-long 400, store-refused 403, clear-refused 403) and no page. "requests": credentialed provider fetches (the former descriptors op). An HttpRequest whose URL carries {{credential}} / {{credential_user}} is filled from secrets.get on the cell_ lane its CONTEXT $APR names in the "credentialLane" parameter (percent-encoded) and re-emitted with its CONTEXT untouched; every other request passes verbatim; one that cannot be filled (foreign lane, nothing stored, an unfilled placeholder) is dropped and reported in ONE FlowNotice Skipped (ITEMS "<provider>=<code>"). Attribution downstream is by CONTEXT, so dropping a request cannot misattribute the others. Every lane is checked for the cell_ prefix before any host call. BATCHING: "catalog" and "credential" are single-stream and a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames"; "requests" is a fan-in port, every frame answered.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The provider catalog as a $QRP projection page stream: id, name, authority, license, attribution, credentialRequired, credentialConfigured, credentialLane, authoritative, defaultSelected, methods, keySlotId, keySlotPublicKey, keySlotAlgorithm.
SDS $APR task from cell-tower-source route: ROUTE credential-put|credential-clear, PARAMETERS providerId + credentialLane, BODY the sealed envelope verbatim (put).
HttpRequest (module-sdk runtime type HREQ); a credentialed one carries {{credential}} in URL and its run contract $APR (with credentialLane) in CONTEXT.
$QRP decision for foundation/http-respond respond_query: a KIND Request carrying the representation, or a KIND Error with HTTP_STATUS, ERROR_CODE and MESSAGE.

outputPorts.description: The decision for the catalog or credential answer.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $QRP projection page stream: the finished catalog, or the credential lane's new state (providerId, credentialLane, credentialConfigured, stored|cleared). Never a credential value.

outputPorts.description: The answer page (absent on a refusal).

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpRequest (HREQ) for hostcap/http-request: the completed credentialed fetch (URL filled, CONTEXT verbatim) or an uncredentialed one verbatim. The URL travels only to the http node and is never logged.
FlowNotice (module-sdk runtime type FNTC): KIND Skipped, REASON credential-unavailable, ITEMS "<provider>=<code>" for each dropped fetch.

outputPorts.description: Which credentialed fetches were dropped and why.
